notes: Meeting dates from the official Federal Reserve FOMC calendar page (source_url), fetched 2026-10-12; Jan-Sep entries show released statements, Oct/Dec are scheduled.
Statement 2:00 PM ET / press conference 2:30 PM ET on the meeting's second day (post-2019 every-meeting policy; corroborated by CME and Fed calendar practice).
Press-conference end is a 60-minute conservative assumption, recorded per event; replace with the verified end when known.
US DST 2026: EDT Mar 8 - Nov 1; EST otherwise. Jan/Dec instants are UTC-5, Mar-Oct are UTC-4.
scheduled_utc values are verified against wall-time + zone at load; any mismatch fails loudly.
